records.name: music
records.prompt: Original gentle music-box lullaby for a cozy pixel-art hot-air-balloon delivery game dedicated to a little girl. Warm celesta and wooden toy piano, soft acoustic plucks, a little airy sustained harmony, 80 bpm lilting three-quarter time in C major. Simple tender repeating melody, light and hopeful, spacious quiet mix. No vocals, no speech, no drums, no chip-wave or arcade bleeps, no loud accents. Begin immediately with the established motif, no intro or outro; return to the same calm tonic harmony for a looping game background. Approximately sixteen short waltz bars.

records.name: burner
records.text: Gentle steady hot-air balloon burner flame, soft warm gas whoosh, close but restrained and smooth, seamless loop, no explosive ignition, no crackling distortion, no music or voices.

records.name: wind
records.text: Very gentle airy breeze high above the clouds, soft smooth natural wind with distant open sky, a seamless quiet ambient loop, no whistling, no storm, no birds, no voices or music.

records.name: creak
records.text: One short soft wicker basket and rope creak under a small shift of weight, warm wooden fibers flex gently, a cozy small sound, no loud impact, no music.

records.name: chime
records.text: One delicate two-note ascending celesta chime for picking up a special parcel in a cozy game, soft rounded music-box bells, cheerful and tiny, no harsh high frequencies, dry isolated sound, no background music.

records.name: giggle
records.text: One small happy soft childlike giggle, a brief innocent joyful laugh after a lovely surprise, no spoken words, no other voices or music, quiet and natural, isolated.

records.name: jingle
records.text: A tiny gentle five-note wooden music-box delivery-success melody resolving warmly in C major. Sweet toy-piano and celesta, tender and cheerful, no drums, no brass, no vocals, isolated short game reward sound with a soft ringing tail.

records.name: thump
records.text: A small cloth sandbag being let go, a soft little sand rustle and muted plop, quiet close fabric and grains, cozy balloon game sound, no metallic or loud impact, no music.
